set.body: Breaking changes are cheap pre-release; do before adoption. (1) Public rectangular plans: plan_geometry(x, right=, at, over) — kernel already supports codec='rectangular' with the decomposition, tested only via ::: (task.R:86, result.R:92, test-effect-form-configuration.R); ordered/pair queries on the plan path; pair-set rdm()/cross-axis rsa(); pair_lm_query covariates on a spatial rectangular plan. Prerequisite for Gate 3 (bd-01M02MV5ZA47MDJTT9CNTPK4VV; relates bd-01KZYBK55CR0T97SE36G9ESPNP). (2) Coupling reachable from the plan: coupling(plan, between, by) sharing frame/pairing/query vocabulary instead of the parallel measurement pipeline; staged plan for lifting the 256MiB small-node ceiling (evidence-api.R:5-24) — searchlight-resolved coupling currently impossible. (3) Naming unification: one public noun for the evidence pairing; resolve 'frame' x3 meanings, geometry_alignment vs geometry_* collision, form-vs-geometry split; absorb connectivity(view=) duplication; crossnobis() gains the decomposition it drops (crossnobis.R:524) or becomes an explicit alias (relates bd-01KZYBK4TPEQZ95V1TKG5WKC0N, bd-01KZY8X53W0DQ8P99AD0V0CF7F). (4) Prune dead exports: inner_product, measurement_bridge, reverse_bridge, measurement_space, pairing_marginals, additive_frame, metric-plumbing quintet (relates bd-01KZYS7XH6G12QV8EYT561EPS3); split the seven one-bit relation-fit capability flags into independently earned bits. (5) Capability introspection: export sampling_capabilities(plan, fit) with the full reason table; plan print shows metric status, generalization axis, covariance availability. Acceptance: a rectangular analysis and a coupling analysis both runnable from one plan vocabulary without :::; export list defensible line by line.
set.title: Phase 3: One calculus, one vocabulary — public rectangular plans, plan-reachable coupling, naming
